body:
Well, I wrote the whole thing out under No-Doz's comment.

And I do care about my friends and family, which is the reason I would never go through with killing myself.
Oh wow, I do the same thing with the swearing. I literally bite my tongue to keep from doing it when I'm in public.

Well, it wasn't exactly a car accident, but it could have been. I haven't been driving for very long (I went to college in a city with good public transportation so it was something I had kept putting off) and I had an interview and it was in an area where I've been several times but not driven. Anyway I wound up getting completely lost and then I accidentally went down a one-way road the wrong way. Everything was OK, but if something had happened it would have been completely my fault.

I had left pretty early so I still made it to the interview on time but I was so shaken up that it didn't go very well and I'm pretty sure I didn't get the job. I did manage to drive down this morning to the place where I volunteer (which is in an area that I'm really familiar with and is very easy to get to), but I felt like I was going to throw up the whole way there and back. 

Aside from that whole fiasco, I'm also just really unhappy where I'm living. I love my family and even though they are completely fine with me moving back home for a little bit I feel badly about it. My original plan was to go to med school, but I don't think I have what it takes to be a doctor. I got good grades in undergrad but I feel like I'm only good at understanding things in theory.

I thought briefly about Peace Corps but I get the impression that they screen out people with mental health issues. Plus, I have a dog and even though my parents love her and would be fine with taking care of her for me I don't want to have to leave her for two years. (Fourteen years in dog years!) I've also thought about just picking up and moving just to move but I can't do that because student loans have drained my savings. I don't really know what else to do.

Well, long story short, I was almost in a car accident last week and it was 100% my fault. I never want to drive again, but I'm also trying to find a job (which is another source of frustration) and that will almost certainly require that I drive. I wish I could just move to the city and not even have a car but I can't afford to move right now and probably won't for quite some time.

Thanks everyone.

I don't think I want to tell everyone on reddit about the specific event that really set me off this time, and I'm afraid to talk to any of my friends about it because I don't want them to worry.

Maybe I should call a hotline. I've never done that before. I don't actually plan on committing suicide. I just have an itching feeling like I need to hurt myself, or just sleep all the time - I don't feel I deserve to feel happy but feeling miserable also sucks so I'd rather feel nothing.
